blocks.html: The data of a price preference to create.

types.name: attribute
types.description: The attribute of the price preference. For example, `region_id` or `currency_code`.

types.name: value
types.description: The value of the price preference. For example, `reg_123` or `usd`.

types.name: is_tax_inclusive
types.description:
Whether prices matching this preference are tax inclusive.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/pricing/tax-inclusive-pricing).
